# PDFLY

> PDFLY is a free, browser-based PDF toolkit with 16 tools. Merge, split, compress, convert, rotate, watermark, lock and unlock PDFs — no sign-up, no watermarks. Files are processed privately and deleted automatically.

Website: https://pdfly.live
Contact: mywebsites0000011@gmail.com

## About

PDFLY offers 16 free PDF tools in one clean, no-sign-up interface. Everything runs fast in your browser or on a secure server, with no watermarks and no account required. Built for students, freelancers, and small businesses who need quick PDF edits without installing software.

## Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfly.live/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one, in any order.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfly.live/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate pages or extract page ranges.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfly.live/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size without losing quality.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfly.live/rotate-pdf): Rotate individual or all pages of a PDF.
- [Reorder Pages](https://pdfly.live/reorder-pages): Rearrange PDF pages with drag-and-drop.
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfly.live/word-to-pdf): Convert Word (.docx) documents to PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfly.live/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable Word (.docx).
- [Excel to PDF](https://pdfly.live/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets to PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://pdfly.live/image-to-pdf): Convert images (JPG, PNG, etc.) to PDF.
- [PDF to Image](https://pdfly.live/pdf-to-image): Export PDF pages as PNG images.
- [Extract Images](https://pdfly.live/extract-images): Extract all images from a PDF.
- [Add Watermark](https://pdfly.live/add-watermark): Add text or image watermarks to PDFs.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://pdfly.live/add-page-numbers): Add page numbers to a PDF.
- [Lock PDF](https://pdfly.live/lock-pdf): Password-protect a PDF with AES-256 encryption.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfly.live/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection from a PDF.
- [QR Code Generator](https://pdfly.live/qr-code-pdf): Generate QR codes and save them as PDF.
